title: API users
intro: Every request to the public api needs a token. Limits apply to each token of a user. Website visitors get a token automatically, with the limits of the Website visitors row.

form.name: Name
form.emailHelp: Signing in on the website with this Google address gives these limits
form.adminHelp: Can sign in to the admin interface with the email address
form.visitorsOffHelp: When off, the website search stops working and every request needs a token.
form.userOffHelp: When off, all tokens of the user are refused and signing in on the website gives the anonymous limits.
form.saved: Saved, the limits apply within seconds

tokenModal.title: New API token
tokenModal.copyNow: Copy the token now, it is only shown once.
tokenModal.howToSend: Send it in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header, or in X-API-Key.
